exercise.instruction_pt: Ouça e responda: quantos anos o Tom tem?
exercise.listen: Hi, I'm Tom. I'm twenty-two and I'm from Canada.
exercise.explanation_pt: Ele disse "twenty-two", que é 22. "Twelve" seria 12 e "twenty" seria 20.

exercise.instruction_pt: Ouça a pergunta e responda que você é do Brasil.
accepted: I'm from Brazil
I am from Brazil
I come from Brazil
From Brazil
Brazil
I'm Brazilian
I am Brazilian
I'm from Brazil, and you?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para dizer de onde você é, use "from", e não "of": "I'm from Brazil".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'm from Brazil.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Falta o verbo "to be": "I am from Brazil" (ou "I'm from Brazil").
commonErrors.correction_en: I'm from Brazil.

exercise.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu tenho 30 anos."
accepted: I'm 30
I am 30
I'm 30 years old
I am 30 years old
I'm 30 years of age

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Em inglês a idade usa o verbo "to be", não "have": "I am 30" ou "I'm 30 years old".
commonErrors.correction_en: I'm 30 years old.

exercise.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Qual é o seu nome?"
accepted: What's your name?
What is your name?
May I have your name?
Can I have your name?
Sorry, what's your name?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para perguntar o nome usamos "What", não "Which": "What's your name?".
commonErrors.correction_en: What's your name?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "How is your name?" é tradução de "Como é seu nome?", mas em inglês a pergunta é "What's your name?".
commonErrors.correction_en: What's your name?

exercise.instruction_pt: Ligue cada palavra ao significado.
Complete a frase.
accepted: is

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Com "she" (e também he e it) o verbo "to be" é "is": "She is a teacher".
commonErrors.correction_en: She is a teacher.

exercise.instruction_pt: Ouça e responda: como a pessoa foi ao trabalho ontem?
exercise.listen: I usually take the bus to work, but yesterday I walked because it was sunny.
options: De ônibus
A pé
De carro
exercise.explanation_pt: "Usually take the bus" é o costume, mas "yesterday I walked" diz que ontem a pessoa foi a pé.

exercise.instruction_pt: Ouça a pergunta e responda que você visitou seus pais.
exercise.listen: What did you do last weekend?
accepted: I visited my parents
I visited my parents last weekend
Last weekend I visited my parents
I went to visit my parents
I went to see my parents
I saw my parents
I visited my mom and dad
Visited my parents

commonErrors.explanation_pt: A pergunta é sobre o passado ("did"), então o verbo vai para o passado: "I visited my parents".
commonErrors.correction_en: I visited my parents.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Na resposta afirmativa não usamos "did": basta o verbo no passado, "I visited my parents".
commonErrors.correction_en: I visited my parents.

exercise.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu fui ao cinema ontem."
accepted: I went to the cinema yesterday
I went to the movies yesterday
Yesterday I went to the cinema
Yesterday I went to the movies
I went to the movie theater yesterday
I went to see a movie yesterday
I went to see a film yesterday

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Go" é irregular: o passado é "went", não "goed".
commonErrors.correction_en: I went to the cinema yesterday.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Com "yesterday" o verbo fica no passado: "I went", e não "I go".
commonErrors.correction_en: I went to the cinema yesterday.

exercise.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Ela é mais alta que o irmão dela."
accepted: She's taller than her brother
She is taller than her brother
She's taller than her brother is

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Adjetivos curtos fazem o comparativo com "-er": "taller", e não "more tall".
commonErrors.correction_en: She's taller than her brother.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: No comparativo, o "que" é "than": "taller than". "That" e "then" são outras palavras.
commonErrors.correction_en: She's taller than her brother.

exercise.instruction_pt: Numa loja de roupas, alguém pergunta "Can I try it on?". O que a pessoa quer?
options: Experimentar a roupa
Tentar um desconto
Devolver a roupa
exercise.explanation_pt: "Try on" é experimentar uma roupa ou um sapato. "Try" sozinho é tentar ou provar.

exercise.instruction_pt: Coloque as palavras na ordem certa.
accepted: Are you going to travel next month?

exercise.instruction_pt: Ouça e escolha o que a pessoa disse.
exercise.listen: I've been working here for three years, but I'm thinking of moving to a company closer to home.
options: Trabalha lá há três anos e pensa em mudar de empresa.
Trabalhou lá por três anos e já saiu da empresa.
Vai começar a trabalhar lá daqui a três anos.
exercise.explanation_pt: "I've been working here for three years" é o present perfect: a pessoa ainda trabalha lá, há três anos. "I'm thinking of moving" mostra que ela pensa em mudar.

exercise.instruction_pt: Ouça a pergunta e responda que você nunca foi a Londres.
exercise.listen: Have you ever been to London?
accepted: No, I haven't
No, I haven't been to London
No, I have never been to London
No, I've never been to London
No, I've never been there
I've never been to London
I have never been to London
No, never
Never
No, I never went to London
No, I haven't, but I'd like to go
No, I've never been, but I'd love to go

commonErrors.explanation_pt: No present perfect usamos o particípio: "I have never been" (ou "gone"), e não "have never went".
commonErrors.correction_en: No, I've never been to London.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: A pergunta começa com "Have you...", então a resposta curta é "No, I haven't".
commonErrors.correction_en: No, I haven't.

exercise.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu moro aqui há cinco anos."
accepted: I've lived here for five years
I have lived here for five years
I've been living here for five years
I have been living here for five years
I've lived here for 5 years now
I've been living here for five years now

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para algo que começou no passado e continua até agora, o inglês usa o present perfect: "I've lived here for five years".
commonErrors.correction_en: I've lived here for five years.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Com um período de tempo (cinco anos) usamos "for". "Since" vem com um ponto de partida, como "since 2020".
commonErrors.correction_en: I've lived here for five years.

exercise.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Se eu tivesse mais tempo, eu viajaria mais."
accepted: If I had more time, I would travel more
If I had more time, I'd travel more
I would travel more if I had more time
I'd travel more if I had more time
If I had more free time, I would travel more

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "if" não usamos "would". A hipótese vai no passado: "If I had more time".
commonErrors.correction_en: If I had more time, I would travel more.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Se eu tivesse" é uma hipótese, então o verbo vai para o passado: "If I had more time, I would...".
commonErrors.correction_en: If I had more time, I would travel more.

exercise.instruction_pt: O que significa "Actually, I live in Rio"?
options: Na verdade, eu moro no Rio.
Atualmente, eu moro no Rio.
Eu moro no Rio de vez em quando.
exercise.explanation_pt: "Actually" é um falso cognato: quer dizer "na verdade". "Atualmente" em inglês é "currently" ou "nowadays".

exercise.instruction_pt: Complete a frase (um hábito do passado que não existe mais).
exercise.sentence: When I was a kid, I ___ to play football every weekend.
accepted: used

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para hábitos do passado usamos "used to" + verbo: "I used to play". "Be used to" é outra coisa (estar acostumado).
commonErrors.correction_en: When I was a kid, I used to play football every weekend.

exercise.instruction_pt: Ouça e escolha o que aconteceu.
exercise.listen: The meeting has been postponed until next Thursday, so you won't need to have the slides ready by tomorrow after all.
options: A reunião foi adiada, e os slides não precisam ficar prontos amanhã.
A reunião foi cancelada, mas os slides precisam ficar prontos amanhã.
A reunião foi antecipada para amanhã, então os slides são urgentes.
exercise.explanation_pt: "Postponed until next Thursday" é adiada para a próxima quinta. "After all" aqui quer dizer "no fim das contas": os slides não são mais para amanhã.

exercise.instruction_pt: Ouça a pergunta e responda que você teria saído mais cedo.
exercise.listen: If you had known about the traffic, what would you have done?
accepted: I would have left earlier
I'd have left earlier
I would've left earlier
I would have left home earlier
I would have left the house earlier
I'd have left home earlier
If I had known, I would have left earlier
If I'd known, I'd have left earlier

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para falar de algo que não aconteceu no passado usamos "would have" + particípio: "I would have left earlier".
commonErrors.correction_en: I would have left earlier.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "would have" vem o particípio. O de "leave" é irregular: "left".
commonErrors.correction_en: I would have left earlier.

exercise.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu mandei consertar meu carro ontem." (outra pessoa consertou)
accepted: I had my car fixed yesterday
I had my car repaired yesterday
I got my car fixed yesterday
I got my car repaired yesterday
Yesterday I had my car fixed
Yesterday I got my car fixed
I took my car to be fixed yesterday
I sent my car to be fixed yesterday
I had my car fixed at the mechanic's yesterday

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Mandar fazer" algo se diz com "have" ou "get" + objeto + particípio: "I had my car fixed".
commonErrors.correction_en: I had my car fixed yesterday.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "I fixed my car" quer dizer que você mesmo consertou. Quando outra pessoa faz o serviço: "I had my car fixed".
commonErrors.correction_en: I had my car fixed yesterday.

exercise.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Eu queria ter estudado mais para a prova." (arrependimento)
accepted: I wish I had studied more for the exam
I wish I'd studied more for the exam
I wish I had studied more for the test
I wish I'd studied more for the test
I should have studied more for the exam
I should have studied more for the test
I regret not studying more for the exam

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Arrependimento sobre o passado: "I wish" + past perfect, "I wish I had studied".
commonErrors.correction_en: I wish I had studied more for the exam.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Eu queria ter..." não se traduz palavra por palavra. Para arrependimento use "I wish I had..." ou "I should have...".
commonErrors.correction_en: I wish I had studied more for the exam.

exercise.instruction_pt: Ligue cada phrasal verb ao significado.
Coloque as palavras na ordem certa (pergunta indireta).
accepted: She asked me where I was going.

exercise.instruction_pt: Ouça e escolha o que a pessoa sente sobre o cargo.
exercise.listen: Had I known how demanding the role would be, I'd never have taken it on. That said, I've learned more in this job than anywhere else.
options: Em parte se arrepende de ter aceitado, mas reconhece que aprendeu muito.
Sabia que o cargo seria exigente e por isso aceitou.
Recusou o cargo porque achou que seria exigente demais.
exercise.explanation_pt: "Had I known..." é uma inversão que significa "se eu soubesse": ela não teria aceitado. "That said" (dito isso) introduz o lado bom: aprendeu muito.

exercise.instruction_pt: Ouça e escolha o que a pessoa quer dizer.
exercise.listen: I know the new project sounds exciting, but let's not get ahead of ourselves. The budget hasn't even been signed off yet.
options: Vamos com calma: o orçamento ainda nem foi aprovado.
Vamos nos adiantar e começar o projeto logo.
O orçamento foi cortado, então o projeto foi cancelado.
exercise.explanation_pt: "Let's not get ahead of ourselves" é "não vamos nos precipitar". "Signed off" é aprovado oficialmente.

exercise.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês: "Mal eu tinha chegado, começou a chover."
accepted: Hardly had I arrived when it started to rain
Hardly had I arrived when it started raining
Hardly had I arrived when it began to rain
No sooner had I arrived than it started to rain
No sooner had I arrived than it started raining
No sooner had I arrived than it began to rain
Scarcely had I arrived when it started to rain
Barely had I arrived when it started to rain
I had hardly arrived when it started to rain
I had hardly arrived when it started raining
I had barely arrived when it started to rain
I'd barely arrived when it started raining
I'd just arrived when it started to rain
As soon as I arrived, it started to rain
As soon as I arrived, it started raining

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Quando a frase começa com "Hardly", "Scarcely" ou "Barely", há inversão: "Hardly had I arrived...".
commonErrors.correction_en: Hardly had I arrived when it started to rain.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "No sooner" combina com "than": "No sooner had I arrived than it started to rain". "When" vai com "hardly".
commonErrors.correction_en: No sooner had I arrived than it started to rain.

exercise.instruction_pt: Diga em inglês, no tom formal de um e-mail: "Fico no aguardo do seu retorno."
accepted: I look forward to hearing from you
I look forward to your reply
I look forward to your response
I look forward to hearing back from you
I am looking forward to hearing from you
I'm looking forward to hearing from you
Looking forward to hearing from you
I look forward to receiving your reply
I await your reply

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Em "look forward to", o "to" é preposição, então vem verbo com -ing: "I look forward to hearing from you".
commonErrors.correction_en: I look forward to hearing from you.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Fico no aguardo do seu retorno" é tradução literal e soa estranha. No e-mail formal, o natural é "I look forward to hearing from you".
commonErrors.correction_en: I look forward to hearing from you.

exercise.instruction_pt: O que significa "She's still sitting on the fence about the job offer"?
options: Ela ainda está em cima do muro, indecisa sobre a proposta.
Ela já recusou a proposta de emprego.
Ela está esperando a proposta chegar.
exercise.explanation_pt: "Sit on the fence" é ficar em cima do muro, sem tomar partido ou sem decidir.

exercise.instruction_pt: Complete a frase.
exercise.sentence: It's high time we ___ a decision.
accepted: made
took

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "It's high time" + sujeito, o verbo vai para o passado, mesmo falando do presente: "It's high time we made a decision".
commonErrors.correction_en: It's high time we made a decision.
